hypothesis: Species rank distance improves a trained compact local correction, not only label transfer.
competing_explanations: Global distance mixes irrelevant species inputs
128 smooth local basis functions remain too biased
Learned corrections still harm unseen base passes
metric_exposure: Frozen 48976 calibration rows from prior species metric; no U/D
centre_selection: 32 per snapshot, source-ID sorted then seeded uniform sampling; same identities in both arms
initialization: all zero coefficients; exact base prediction
bandwidth: median nearest-centre squared distance on first 4096 non-centre training rows, per metric/species
degeneracy: zero median -> median positive distance -> 1; record fallback
basis: Gaussian normalized by 1 plus sum of all centre Gaussians; zero anchor
objective: coordinate Smooth L1 beta=log(1.1), plus 1e-6 mean squared coefficients
optimizer: Adam; cosine lr 0.01 to 0.0001; default betas; no gradient clipping
checkpoint: final update only; training diagnostics at 0,1000,...,6000
inference: states -> frozen GBCT -> fixed features -> learned basis coefficients -> stable signed increment; no labels or projection
scoring: unchanged research/campaign.json and evaluator-lock.json; against anchor and incumbent
timing: 1023 states, one warmup then 10 alternating end-to-end candidate/base measurements

outcomes.species_gain: Inspect repair and damage; qualification still requires beating GBCT and every guard
outcomes.both_poor_fit: Inspect training curves and effective basis rank/support before a local-order change
outcomes.training_only: Investigate locality/transfer rather than add width
